title: Gazebo
scene: Early Italian Italo disco and synth-pop
notes: Romantic piano hooks and Oberheim-driven disco frame intimate vocals and cinematic songs.

title: Telephone Mama
notes: Less formulaic second album combines keyboard-led songs with documented guitar parts.

title: Univision
notes: Linn-driven synth-pop with rhythm guitar; Gazebo independently produces the track Pain.

title: The Rainbow Tales
scene: Late-1980s Italian synth-pop with a pop/rock turn
notes: Self-directed studio work stretches toward pop-rock alongside synth-pop and electronic dance textures.
